title: DNA extraction from tunicates
author: Marta Wawrzyniak
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b33sqqne

steps.title: Clean slide for colony collection
steps.instruction: Clean the slide from which the colony will be taken.

steps.title: Isolate cleaned colony
steps.instruction: Isolate a cleaned colony composed of approximately 20 zooids.

steps.title: Transfer colony and spin
steps.instruction: Transfer the colony to a tube and centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Remove excess water
steps.instruction: Remove the excess water from the tube.

steps.title: Add glass beads (fresh samples)
steps.instruction: If working with fresh samples, add 0.1 mm glass beads to the tube.

steps.title: Shake tube on thermal shaker
steps.instruction: If working with fresh samples, shake the tube on an Eppendorf thermal shaker at 900 rpm.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Ph‑Ch‑IA solution and 350 µL SDS‑Lysis buffer to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for 45 seconds.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Vortex again
steps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for 45 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature at maximum speed for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Heat at 70 °C (10 min)
steps.instruction: Heat the tubes at 70 °C for 10 minutes, mixing regularly by inversion.

steps.title: Vortex after heating
steps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for 45 seconds.

steps.title: Cool on ice again
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Vortex again
steps.instruction: Vortex at maximum speed for 45 seconds.

steps.title: Heat at 70 °C (2 min)
steps.instruction: Heat the tubes at 70 °C for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer 400 µL aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Add Ph‑Cl‑IA (400 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL Ph‑Cl‑IA solution to the new tube.

steps.title: Invert shake (30 s)
steps.instruction: Shake the tube by inversion for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge (400 µL step)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer 300 µL aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 300 µL of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Add Ph‑Cl‑IA (300 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL Ph‑Cl‑IA solution to the new tube.

steps.title: Invert shake (30 s) – 300 µL
steps.instruction: Shake the tube by inversion for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge (300 µL step)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer 200 µL aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the upper aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Add Cl‑IA (200 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Cl‑IA solution to the new tube.

steps.title: Invert shake (30 s) – 200 µL
steps.instruction: Shake the tube by inversion for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge (200 µL step)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer remaining aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of 100 % ethanol (≈300‑400 µL) and 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (≈15‑20 µL); mix by inversion.

steps.title: Incubate at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at –20 °C for 3 hours.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA pellet (cold)
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, maximum speed for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 80 % ethanol (450 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 450 µL cold 80 % ethanol to the pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge after first wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature, maximum speed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 80 % ethanol (200 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL cold 80 % ethanol to the pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge after second wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at room temperature, maximum speed for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in ultra‑pure water (typically 20‑100 µL).

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA concentration using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the DNA at –20 °C for short‑term storage or at –80 °C for long‑term storage.
